reviewed_proof_scopes.semantic_scope: The finite-ranking model, three formal definitions, Propositions 1 through 4, their displayed pairwise and aggregate rate formulas, finite-sample bounds, and the appendix derivations by prefix summation, the Proposition 1 strict-reverse and exact-equality cases with independent uniform tie breaking, finite-support large deviations, ternary score gaps, and finite log-sum aggregation.

The randomized-mechanism model, arbitrary-goal scoring non-improvement theorem, fixed-pair randomized K-approval theorem, Mallows no-randomization corollary, and the convexity and pivotal-pair proof routes.

The two existence results showing that randomized approval can improve W-selection and that W-approval need not be Mallows-rate-optimal, including the fixed examples, probability/rate calculations, design-invariance construction, and parameter feasibility argument.

The advertised efficient dynamic program for exact joint locations of an arbitrary pair of candidates under Mallows repeated insertion, including the operational materialized-table runner, recurrence and PMF refinement semantics, normalization, exact scalar-operation accounting, and the polynomial bound.
